sublibraries.description: The most basic experiment on chip: motifs were defined as two-way junctions of varying topologies, and were inserted into chip scaffolds of length 8-12 bp, and in three different positions in the length 9 and 10 bp scaffolds. Two different flanking sequences of the junctions were employed.

A subset of motifs studied in the “junction_conformation” section were put into additional positions within tectoRNA scaffolds. Essentially, motifs were put into each position within scaffolds of length 8-11 bp that preserved the flanking sequence of the motif (“along”).
Similar to above, with additional positions that did not conserve all of the base pairs of the motif
The two flanking WC base pairs of certain two-way junctions were comprehensively varied at a single position within tectoRNA helices of length 9 and 10 bp.
Every two-way junction that was crystallized in the PDB crystal structure database was inserted into scaffolds of length 8-12 bp, and in three different positions within length 9 and 10 bp.
The same as “along” except with motifs from the PDB crystal structure database.
Several mutations were made in the tertiary contact receptor, and the effect of these mutations was measured in multiple tectoRNA scaffolds.
